procedure.method: Independent fresh portfolio critic session; no spawned, resumed or forked agents and no peer/producer/planner records inspected. Read the pinned packet, literal case, review rules, rubric, recording addendum and method/schema; read and verified all five pinned native-evidence manifests before poster viewing, without following their unlisted embedded paths. The packet declares no source assets or protected-layout manifests, so both source receipt arrays are explicitly empty. Verified exact poster hashes, byte sizes and PNG headers read-only. Actually opened and displayed each exact pinned poster via tools.view_image with detail original, sequentially M1 native/usage720/thumbnail320, M2 native/usage720/thumbnail320, M3 native/usage720/thumbnail320, M4 native/usage720/thumbnail320, then M5 native/usage720/thumbnail320. All fifteen were completed before the first copy-reading/transcription stage, judgment or score. Then recorded 60 first raw readings from the displayed native pixels, retaining observed soft wraps, tracked type as optical layout, and dot spacing; no OCR, crop, replacement asset or revisit was used. Quality judgments also use the already displayed usage and thumbnail views. No opening event, serialized tool event identity or runtime session ID is invented. All native dimensions are 1672×941, usage views 720×405, thumbnails 320×180; the native ratio is accepted by the predeclared 0.5-pixel single-edge height-rounding tolerance, not mathematical equality.

content_form.location: upper macro planter and lower-left display
content_form.observation: The healthy plant range fits the subject, but the concept remains a polished foliage showcase. Choosing is suggested by a row of pots; the social market and the practice of home care have little specific visual articulation beyond thriving plants and soil.

typography.location: two-line Korean serif title and sans-serif supporting text

Body and visit information remain readable, with visible separation between primary facts and service lines.

space.location: pale center/right clearings and occupied left/top edges
space.observation: Text margins respond to the plant masses, with a deliberate narrow title zone, wider explanation zone and separated visit column. The left row recedes into space rather than becoming a tiny inset.

image_material.location: base of upper planter versus lower row of pots
image_material.observation: The large upper planter dissolves into a pale blur while the smaller pots sit on a receding bench. The scale and support relationship does not read as a fully coherent scene; the very slick leaf highlights further flatten the photographic montage.

emotion_control.observation: Sunlight and abundant green convey freshness, but the oversized pristine foliage and showroom-like rows produce a fairly generic lush-plant mood; the specific pleasure of selecting and caring feels less developed.

ai_slop.location: upper planter's fading underside and foreground pot surfaces

residuals: Choosing and caring are suggested through a healthy plant display rather than a developed specific visual relationship.

content_form.observation: The plant collection is substantive, but the image communicates abundant greenery more than the particular pleasures of choosing plants and learning to care for them. There is no comparably specific care relationship or interaction.

hierarchy.location: date at top, explanation center-left, services lower-right and identity bottom-left
hierarchy.observation: The date is emphatic, but the remaining groups are distributed among separate islands with weak linkage. The identity reads last, and the eye has to move sideways from the paragraph to services, then back down-left.

typography.location: five-line explanation and lower service block
typography.observation: The copy is accurate and readable, but most supporting text uses similarly heavy bold type. Short stacked lines and closely packed service lines reduce nuance between narrative, secondary facts and invitation.

space.location: center paragraph's right edge and lower-left title island
space.observation: Leaf tips constrain the irregular clearings close to the type; the narrow paragraph, crowded service island and small bottom identity pocket feel fitted between foliage rather than fully balanced with it.

image_material.location: large left monstera, upper trailing vine and pink planters
image_material.observation: Angular layered leaves, simple veins, flat color planes and consistent pink pots form a coherent graphic material system, with enough species variation to remain legible as a collection.

emotion_control.observation: Dense green forms create lushness, but the uninterrupted foliage wall and compressed text clearings give a more generic botanical-poster feeling than a particular relaxed browsing or nurturing experience.

ai_slop.location: leaf edges, veins and planter silhouettes

residuals: Care and selection are indirect; the visual concept is primarily a lush plant collection.
The date-first, multi-island reading route leaves the identity and services weakly connected to the explanation.

space.observation: The image crops establish strong blocks, but the text panel is vertically overfilled: large invitation, paragraph, divider, and visit stack leave very little bottom space. The separate identity strip is compressed into the leafy lower corner.

image_material.location: upper plant display and right hands with root ball
image_material.observation: The consistent warm painterly light links the crops, and the visible root ball, container rim and hands make the care operation intelligible. Large scene crops have a clear narrative function.

emotion_control.location: sunlit market and repotting images with invitation headline
emotion_control.observation: The invitation and warm scenes convey a relaxed welcome followed by practical nurturing. The emotional connection is specific even though reading the small supporting copy is less comfortable.

ai_slop.observation: Pot forms, exposed root ball and handling hands are identifiable and share a coherent painterly treatment. The coarse mottled textures are pervasive but do not introduce major arbitrary objects or contradictory text.

residuals: Comfortable usage720 reading fails for the small explanation, secondary services and lower-left slogan.

evidence.location: whole macro montage and horizontal reading route
evidence.observation: A large cropped planter dominates the upper field; serif identity at left, paragraph in the middle and ruled visit column at right create three horizontal reading stations. It shares pale botanical framing with M3/M4, but its macro viewpoint, photo montage and three-column type roles differ from their date-led islands and body-led page.

evidence.location: whole continuous counter scene and orange slogan
evidence.observation: Two people and the bench create a diagonal market/care narrative, with the orange slogan leading the upper left and practical facts on the counter at lower right. This continuous inhabited scene and slogan-first route are distinct from M1/M4's botanical surrounds, M3's date-first islands and M5's cropped sequence.

evidence.location: date-led foliage clearings and bottom identity
evidence.observation: The primary date sits high in a pale irregular opening; narrative and service groups occupy separate foliage-contoured islands, while the identity is lower left. Its image geometry and date-first route change the whole organization, not only the material, although leafy framing relates it to M1 and M4.

evidence.location: large narrative block, mature tree and visit rows
evidence.observation: The explanation is the main text mass, with a small identity above, a mature trunk anchoring the right edge and horizontal factual rows below. The plant border resembles M1/M3, but paragraph scale, mature-tree emphasis, root reveal and horizontal information structure establish a different reading system.

evidence.location: dark invitation panel and three image crops
evidence.observation: A tall domestic-plant strip, shallow market strip and large repotting crop surround a dark invitation-led panel; identity sits in the left image. The segmented viewpoint, dark/light relations and invitation-first route differ from each of the four largely continuous pale botanical/scene compositions.

residuals: Green foliage, warm pale surfaces and botanical framing recur across the set; M1, M3 and M4 have the closest family resemblance.
The diversity score reflects changed spatial organization, viewpoints, type roles and reading routes across every member, not a count of material labels.
Diversity at 4 does not cancel the low individual dimensions or M5's literal usage-readability failure.
This is one independent portfolio assessment of the five pinned selected images; no three-critic aggregate or transfer claim is made.
